compatibilityNotes: The new synthetic CSV template explicitly declares native Region/string and Sales/real field metadata. The reference template omitted this metadata, which caused an actual Tableau Cloud run to reject the Sales calculation; existing imported native metadata is preserved.

Value/metadata/type/attachment equivalence is checked; YAML formatting and ZIP compression/timestamps are not a byte identity promise across Python and Node. Preview/generate within Node releases byte-identical reviewed archives.
The retained matching authoring schema is not the reference project later exhaustive node catalog. Native Tableau execution remains unverified.
Only bounded store/deflate native ZIP members (including ZIP64) are supported. No native Tableau binary or external script is executed.
The immutable fixture contains synthetic data and expected reference results; the private twelve-flow corpus is not redistributed.
Python is used only as a development oracle at migration time; shipped source/runtime and ongoing Node regression tests require no Python.
